name: ralphex-revmux
description: Make revmux the external reviewer of a ralphex run — live review preflight (codex auth round-trip, revmux + profile resolution), the custom_review_script glue that opens one revmux round per ralphex external-review iteration, a two-stage runner (--tasks-only then --external-only) that skips ralphex's own multi-lane review loops, and two post-run agents: a forensic run reporter and a proposal-only optimizer. REQUIRES the ralphex and revmux CLIs; PAIRS with revmux-kit for the sol-*/fable-* profiles.
